{{Attr|Burn}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Ice Beacon''' is a [[Flying]] enemy that appears in the [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode. Like most of that mode's enemies, it first appeared in the [[Operation I.C.E Event]]. It has a high amount of health, but it moves at a ridiculously slow speed, so slow it is basically immobile. This enemy's only purpose is being used by the [[Frost Spirit]] during its ''Ice Beacon'' ability. ==Appearance== The '''Ice Beacon''' is a floating crystal made out of ice. ==Strategy== *The only way for this enemy to kill you is if you purposefully try to die, or if it spawned at the exit, which is very unlikely to happen. Therefore, just having a lot of flying detection DPS is enough to destroy this. **Towers with splash damage capabilities can help with this, as they can hit multiple of them at once. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseBeacon.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} IceBeaconIconIG.png|'''Ice Beacon''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Ice Beacon''' is the only enemy from the [[Operation I.C.E Event]] to not have a description in the [[Index]]. *The '''Ice Beacon''' is the second slowest enemy in the game, only behind the [[Void Eye]]. *The '''Ice Beacon's''' model comes from the [[Accelerator/Gallery|{{Color|FallenMission|Fallen}} Accelerator]]'s crystal. ==Update History== *'''16 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0]] **'''Ice Beacon''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Ice Beacon''' floats above the ground when made larger or smaller. *'''15 January 2024''' - [[v1.49.0]] **'''Ice Beacon''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''3 December 2025''' - [[v1.82.0]] **'''Ice Beacon''' re-added to the main game, now appears in [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode. ***Has 20,000 health in [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode. **Health increased from 15,000 to 20,000 in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''22 May 2026''' - [[v1.91.0]] **{{Bugfix}} No longer floats above the ground when made larger or smaller. *'''28 August 2026''' - [[v2.8.0]] **Health decreased from 20,000 to 6,250 in [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode. **Health decreased from 20,000 to 2,500 in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. **[[Flying]] added. **[[Freeze Immunity]] removed. **[[Burn Immunity]] removed. **Size increased. {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Frost]]
